name: The Dead Fields
summary: The Dead Fields is an assault mission issued by High Executor Hadrec from the Sepulcher. Forsaken scouts discovered that the Rot Hide gnolls infesting an abandoned northern farmstead are led and shielded by the Scourge banshee Nightlash, whose destruction is critical to securing Silverpine Forest.

sections.title: A Plague upon the Fields
sections.body: North of the Sepulcher lies an abandoned farmstead known as the Dead Fields. Once ordinary farmland, the grounds are now choked by Rot Hide gnolls—pestilent, plagued scavengers that infest the Silverpine countryside. High Executor Hadrec previously sent small raiding parties to dislodge them, but every offensive stalled under unnatural magical resistance.

sections.title: The Banshee's Grasp
sections.body: The Rot Hides are not acting merely on feral instinct; they are reinforced by the Scourge. A banshee named Nightlash oversees the area, using dark sorcery to scatter Forsaken skirmishers whenever the gnolls face ruin. Hadrec dispatches Horde champions to cut down the gnolls until Nightlash is lured out, demanding her spectral essence as proof of her demise.

faq.q: Where are the Dead Fields located?
faq.answer: The Dead Fields are situated north of the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. It is an overgrown, decaying farmstead heavily overrun by Rot Hide gnolls.
Nightlash is a Scourge banshee who commands and shields the Rot Hide gnolls at the Dead Fields, using dark magic to drive off previous Forsaken assault parties.

faq.q: Why are gnolls working with a banshee?
faq.answer: The Rot Hide gnolls of Silverpine Forest are tainted by the plague of undeath. The Scourge uses figures like Nightlash to direct these rabid creatures as vanguard foot soldiers against the Forsaken.

faq.q: How do you draw out Nightlash?
faq.answer: Nightlash remains hidden until the gnolls under her protection are slaughtered in large numbers. Slaying enough Rot Hides forces her to manifest in the middle of the field to defend her domain.

faq.q: Who gives the quest The Dead Fields?
faq.answer: High Executor Hadrec, the Forsaken military commander stationed at the Sepulcher, issues the quest as part of his campaign to secure the region.

faq.q: What happens after Nightlash is destroyed?
faq.answer: Bringing Nightlash's essence to High Executor Hadrec proves the Scourge has lost a vital presence in northern Silverpine, leading Hadrec to turn your attention toward the Decrepit Ferry east of the Sepulcher.

angles.text: For the Forsaken, destroying Nightlash is a personal strike against the Scourge and a grim reminder of the spectral torment Sylvanas and her banshees broke away from.
Breaking the Scourge hold over northern Silverpine Forest helps safeguard the travel corridor linking the Undercity to the southern territories of Lordaeron.
